chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, as part of the sanad/isnad
key_terms.ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ: Ibn Faḍḍāl, a narrator in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام, the reported source of the hadith
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the same as it; indicating the matn matches the previous report

ai.seo_question: What does "مِثْلَهُ" mean in a hadith of Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām with a separate sanad/isnad?
ai.summary: This entry gives a brief sanad/isnad leading to al-Riḍā عليه السلام, then states "the like of it," indicating that the ruling or wording is the same as the preceding hadith. In context, it functions as a transmitted corroboration of the previous legal report in the chapter on diyāt of limbs and injuries and retaliation therein.
